story.titleZh: 与@Valvoline共同培养下一代，回顾墨西哥新一代机械师的发展
story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁与Valvoline合作培养下一代机械师，回顾他们在墨西哥的学习和发展过程。
story.originalTitle: Building the next generation with @Valvoline. Taking a look back at the next generation of mechanics in Mexico, developing their skills in the classro...
story.summaryEn:
Building the next generation with @Valvoline.
Taking a look back at the next generation of mechanics in Mexico, developing their skills in the classroom before taking their learning trackside.
Because every Original starts somewhere, and never stops learning.
detailZh:
与@Valvoline共同打造下一代。
回顾墨西哥下一代机械师，他们在教室里提升技能，然后在赛道边继续学习。
因为每个原厂产品都始于某个地方，并且永远不会停止学习。
detailEn:
Building the next generation with @Valvoline.
Taking a look back at the next generation of mechanics in Mexico, developing their skills in the classroom before taking their learning trackside.
Because every Original starts somewhere, and never stops learning.
